//: The test build. Compiles src, headless and test together into tmp/test,
which `node --test` then runs. Separate from tsconfig.json because the site
output must contain the application and nothing else — a test helper
shipped to the browser is a dependency nobody decided to take.
The directory is not dot-prefixed on purpose: node's test runner skips
hidden directories, so `node --test .tmp/test` silently finds nothing.
`headless/` is here so the batch runner is type-checked and tested by the
same `npm test` as everything else. It is emitted for running by
tsconfig.headless.json instead; this build only has to compile it.
